meta.parties: Sumangala Unnanse v. Dhammarakkita Et Al

rules.statement: The decision of the Maha Sanga Sabhawa is not binding on the parties if it was improperly made, as evidenced by the exclusion of important evidence.
rules.supporting_quote: "Moreover, the order of February 12, 1904, was attacked by the second defendant as having been improperly made; a good deal of the evidence was directed to that point, and at the close of the evidence the plaintiff's counsel admitted that it is competent for the Court to set aside the award (meaning the order) on grounds of irregularity or misconduct; and I agree with the District Judge that the order was improperly made, because the most important evidence was improperly excluded."
